one_line: Nvidia faces leadership turmoil and export control scrutiny amid investigations into CEO departure and China chip sales.

themes.title: Nvidia faces leadership transition and earnings
themes.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following an investigation into personal relationships, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO as the board evaluates succession options. The chipmaker faces an upcoming earnings report and potential leadership changes amid wider government scrutiny.

themes.title: Scrutiny mounts over China chip sales
themes.text: US officials and lawmakers are investigating Southeast Asian data centers and export routes that supplied Nvidia AI chips to Chinese companies. The scrutiny involves policy clashes within the administration, congressional inquiries, and new allied measures to protect AI supply chains from China.
